note: One SCB event says variable 300 (FORNAMN) is replaced by variable 999, which no register delivers, so the build reports unresolved_source_event_endpoint. sample.toml acknowledges it with both digests, copied as a curator copies them from the stale entry's current pins: no placeholder renders an event acknowledgement's digests. Here the input repository holds the SCB snapshot at `snapshot`; step 2 builds the same delivery from `catalog/snapshot` with the same pins (#1763).
fails_if: an SCB event's evidence digest stops covering the event row's own content, so an exact acknowledgement goes stale; or `clean_timeseries_row` (reg_meta_build/src/reg_meta_build/sources/scb_reference_records.py) locates the row by the revision's artifact_path instead of the bare Timeseries.csv, which puts the input layout in the digest

sources.description: Register 1 delivers FORNAMN (variable 300) in 2020; its one event says variable 300 is replaced by variable 999, which no register delivers.
